testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle the direct panel list without changing a checkbox: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:225:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle the direct panel list without changing a checkbox ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left with the Modify panel visible ✔ When the user clicks the direct panel selector arrow ✔ Then the panel list opens with Modify checked ✔ When the user clicks the direct panel selector arrow again ✔ Then the panel list closes ✔ And the Modify panel remains visible
